_comment: VoxyTok - one isolated instance for one bot/application, with embedded PostgreSQL
name: VoxyTok
author: Kua <https://github.com/KuaFeur>
description: Official TikTok Display API gateway. Each creator explicitly authorizes this one bot instance. PostgreSQL is bundled.

variables.name: HTTP Port
variables.description: Internal HTTP listen port. Allocate and expose this port in Pelican.

variables.name: Bot Webhook URL
variables.description: The single webhook destination for the bot attached to this VoxyTok instance.

variables.name: Webhook Signing Secret
variables.description: Optional HMAC-SHA256 secret used to sign outgoing webhook requests.

variables.name: PostgreSQL Database
variables.description: Local database name inside the container.

variables.name: PostgreSQL Password
variables.description: Use 24-128 random URL-safe characters: letters, digits, underscore or hyphen.

variables.name: PostgreSQL Port
variables.description: Internal PostgreSQL port. Do not allocate or expose this port publicly.

variables.name: API Bearer Token
variables.description: Secret used to authenticate management API requests. Generate at least 32 random characters.

variables.name: TikTok Client Key
variables.description: TikTok for Developers app client key (Login Kit + Display API).

variables.name: TikTok Client Secret
variables.description: TikTok developer app secret. Stored only in server environment.

variables.name: TikTok OAuth Redirect URI
variables.description: Exact HTTPS callback URL registered in TikTok for Developers.

variables.name: Token Encryption Key
variables.description: 32-byte AES-256-GCM key as 64 hex characters. Generate once and back it up; losing it requires creators to reconnect.
